intended_utility: market-neutral swing/carry sleeve, not day trading or a standalone SPY challenger
evidence_strength: funding cash flow is contractual; persistence and after-cost profitability are unproven

decision.funding_history: three most recent settled funding rows whose calc_time plus five minutes is <= decision time
decision.basis_observation: fully closed 23:30-00:00 UTC spot and perpetual kline closes

entry_signal.economic_rationale: at three settlements per day for seven days, 0.5 approximate perpetual capital weight times 21 times 3 bps projects 31.5 capital bps, exceeding the 25 bps simple conservative hurdle before mean reversion

position.entry: 00:30 UTC exact spot and perpetual kline opens
position.exit: 00:30 UTC exact kline opens seven calendar days later
position.quantity: same BTC quantity on both legs, q = 1 / (spot_entry + perpetual_entry), giving exactly 1.0 initial gross notional per unit capital
position.legs: long q BTC spot and short q BTC perpetual
position.funding_events: credit every actual funding row with calc_time in (entry, exit], including a settlement before the exit on the exit date
position.funding_payment: q * mark_price_at_settlement * settled_funding_rate; positive rate is received by the short
position.mark_proxy: mark-price 30m kline open whose open_time is the settlement timestamp floored to 30 minutes
position.missing_data: skip candidate if any exact entry/exit price, funding mark, or required signal observation is missing

holdout_policy: If any development gate fails, stop. Do not change funding threshold/history, holding period, entry clock, basis condition, add OI/flow filters, rebalance, overlap trades, alter costs, add leverage/ML, or inspect later partitions to rescue it.
